name: Motorcycle Simulator Colorado
summary:
Ride Denver from the seat - alone, or with up to three friends.

31 KM OF REAL DENVER
I-25 south past Empower Field at Mile High and the downtown towers, Colfax, Broadway and Washington Park, then Colorado Boulevard north through Cherry Creek and past City Park, and I-70 west back into the Mousetrap.

RIDE IT LIKE A REAL BIKE
Grip the bars with your own hands. Roll your right wrist back to open the throttle, brake with your left hand, push the bars to lean into a corner. Tuck behind the screen for top speed
